title: Producing $Λ(1405)$ and $Λ(1520)$ in $π^-p$ reaction to explore their inner structures
summary: In this work, the production mechanisms of the hyperon resonances $Λ(1405)$ and $Λ(1520)$ in the $π^- p$ scattering are investigated within an effective Lagrangian approach incorporating Regge trajectories. By including contributions from $t$-channel $K^*$ and $u$-channel $Σ$ exchanges, we perform global fits to the total and differential cross sections for $π^{-} p \rightarrow KΛ(1405)$ and $π^{-} p \rightarrow KΛ(1520)$.
